description: Collection of functions for structured pruning of linear and conv2d modules, including bias propagation utilities.

methods.name: _remove_bias_handles
methods.description: Removes bias handles (BiasHook instances) from a module's forward hooks.

methods.name: _get_adjusted_next_layer_bias
methods.description: Calculates and returns an adjusted bias parameter for the next layer after pruning.

methods.name: _prune_module_bias
methods.description: Prunes the bias of a module according to a mask.

methods.name: _propagate_module_bias
methods.description: Propagates biases through modules, returning biases to be propagated.

methods.name: _prune_linear_helper
methods.description: Helper function to prune a linear layer's weights and biases.

methods.name: prune_linear
methods.description: Prunes a linear layer's weights and optionally its bias.

methods.name: prune_linear_linear
methods.description: Prunes the connection between two linear layers.

methods.name: prune_linear_activation_linear
methods.description: Prunes a linear layer, applies activation to biases if provided, and adjusts the next layer.

methods.name: _prune_conv2d_helper
methods.description: Helper function to prune a Conv2d layer's weights and biases.

methods.name: prune_conv2d_padded
methods.description: Prunes a Conv2d layer with padding, adjusting biases accordingly.

methods.name: prune_conv2d
methods.description: Prunes a Conv2d layer's weights and optionally its bias.

methods.name: prune_conv2d_conv2d
methods.description: Prunes the connection between two Conv2d layers.

methods.name: prune_conv2d_activation_conv2d
methods.description: Prunes a Conv2d layer, applies activation to biases, and adjusts the next Conv2d layer.

methods.name: prune_conv2d_pool_activation_conv2d
methods.description: Prunes a Conv2d layer with pooling and activation, then prunes subsequent Conv2d.

methods.name: prune_conv2d_activation_pool_conv2d
methods.description: Prunes a Conv2d layer with activation, pooling, and subsequent Conv2d.

methods.name: prune_conv2d_pool_flatten_linear
methods.description: Prunes a Conv2d layer, maps pruned indices through flattening, and adjusts a following Linear layer.

methods.name: prune_lstm_output_linear
methods.description: Prunes the output layer of an LSTM, including layer normalization if present.

methods.name: prune_lstm_output_layernorm_linear
methods.description: Prunes LSTM hidden-to-output weights and biases, adjusts layernorm if present.
